items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: This is my husband, Franz Calvin Bibelet.

ctx.x: You lost 35 pounds. 35 pounds, yes, indeed. Uh-huh.

Now, this is my family. My family taking in the patio. You can see with all the leaves how my garden has gone. This is, um, my sister. She lives in Buffalo, New York. Mrs. Causey. Mrs. Susan B. Causey. This is my brother, Clarence Bibelet. Clarence Bibelet. He lives up on Cater Street. This is me, Edna Bibelet. This is my husband, Franz Calvin Bibelet. And this is the children. This is Edwin, Newmire. You heard of the, um, the school, the Martinez Children's School? Oh, Martinez.
